decode: id = P{i}_{j}_{vca}_{vcb}_{op}.  i and j index `holders`; vca and vcb are value-class NAMES, not indices; op is the operation spelled literally.  Value-class names and operation spellings can both contain underscores and spaces, so an id is decoded by MATCHING against this manifest's enumeration, never by splitting the string on underscores.

value_classes:
shape_r5 = Struct.new(:a, :b, :c, :d, :e)
v = shape_r5.new(1, "two", 3.0, true, nil)

shape_r3 = Data.define(:a, :b, :c)
v = shape_r3.new(a: 1, b: 2, c: 3)

enumeration_order: i outer, then j, then value class of i, then value class of j, then operation
